conviction_note: Q3 is not pre-released: since 2026 grenke has dropped its October new-business release, so the new-business, loss-rate and earnings lines are all new on the day. The negatives are mostly arithmetic on the company's own guide. H1 new business grew +1.4% (Q2 -1.0%), and H2 needs about +4.5% to reach the EUR 3.4bn low end. The earnings guide may narrow to its lower half, which is what drew -4.46% on Q3 2025. Both are partly priced: consensus EPS of 1.37 (6 analysts) already sits near the low end of the earnings guide, and the stock is at its 52-week low. On the positive side, no ad-hoc profit warning has been filed (unlike October 2024), and the CEO and CFO bought after the quarter closed. Findings sum to -1.7; the scaled number (-0.66 = 0.88 x 5.5) is smaller because p_up sits only slightly below 50, since every negative is an inference from public numbers.

findings.finding: The new-business guide is arithmetically stretched. Reaching the EUR 3.4bn low end needs H2 2026 of about EUR 1,755m against about 1,680m in H2 2025 (+4.5%), while H1 grew 1.4% and Q2 fell 1.0%. The Q3 statement may therefore move the volume guide below the range or soften its wording.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Weak new business drew -2.89% on 13 Aug 2026 (the 'lower end' wording) and -2.95% on the 2 Oct 2025 new-business release; the 7 Jan 2026 FY new-business print 'meets guidance' drew +1.95%.
findings.why_not_priced: The board still formally guides 3.4-3.6bn and has not filed a change. If the market had priced a sub-range volume year, the H1 'lower end' language would have been read as a cut and the stock would sit lower on the Q3 base. It is 4.5% below the post-H1 level, though, so part of this is in the price.
findings.independence: Q3 2025 base of EUR 781.2m (+5.8%) and FY2025 EUR 3.3bn: https://www.eqs-news.com/news/corporate/grenke-meets-annual-guidance-with-eur-3-3-billion-in-leasing-new-business/862e2088-e5ac-44fa-9943-2abda01fb707_en

findings.finding: The earnings guide is likely to be narrowed toward its lower half. H1 earnings were EUR 32.6m, so H2 needs at least 41.4m against 45.6m in H2 2025, at a loss rate of about 2% against 1.9% in Q3 2025. Last year's Q3 statement made exactly that move ('likely to reach the lower half') and the stock fell 4.46% on the day.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 2025: guide reiterated but steered to the lower half, -4.46% (13 Nov 2025). Q3 2024: ad-hoc profit warning in October, a large drop. FY guides in Mar 2025 and Mar 2026: -18.8% and -8.9%.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: FY consensus EPS of 1.37 maps to about EUR 76m, already in the lower half of 74-86m. What may not be priced is the company saying so explicitly, which on this name has repeatedly been sold. A fully priced reaction would show consensus at or below 74m.

findings.finding: CM2 margin pressure: the ECB raised rates in June and September 2026 (deposit rate 2.50%, held on 29 Oct). Grenke states that lease terms adjust to rate moves only with a lag, so the H2 CM2 margin is at risk of falling below its own cut guide of about 16% (Q2 was 15.6%).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The CM2 margin slip to 15.6% was part of the -2.89% on 13 Aug 2026.
findings.original_quote: Bundesbank release of the ECB decisions, as summarised in search: the three key rates held at 2.50%, 2.65% and 2.90% (the PDF itself was not opened)
findings.why_not_priced: This is macro-to-company transmission; the company has named the lag mechanism but not quantified the H2 effect. A priced version would show analysts cutting 2027 EPS, and consensus 2027 is still 1.61, +18%.
findings.independence: H1 report: the CM2 decline is 'primarily attributable to the usual time lag between interest rate movements and the adjustment of lending terms', https://www.eqs-news.com/news/corporate/grenke-increases-group-earnings-in-the-first-half-of-2026/adc414c9-4afa-4b01-9b03-40ce77f12d5d_en

findings.finding: No ad-hoc profit warning has been filed since the H1 report: the EQS-News archive for GRENKE shows only two directors' dealings after 13 Aug 2026. In October 2024 grenke did file an ad-hoc profit warning before its Q3, so MAR silence after the quarter closed points to Q3 earnings inside the 74-86m track.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: October 2024 ad-hoc profit warning: the stock 'stürzte böse ab' (Börsen-Zeitung, 'Grenke schockt Aktionäre mit Gewinnwarnung').
findings.why_not_priced: The stock sits near its 52-week low (9.69-9.73) and fell to 9.73 in early October on heavy volume with no filed cause, which reads as if part of the market feared another October warning. If the silence were priced, the stock would have recovered to the post-H1 11+ level.

findings.finding: CEO Hirsch (1,500 shares at about EUR 9.83) and CFO Paal (1,000 shares at EUR 9.78) bought on 8 Oct 2026. That is after Q3 closed and just outside the 30-day MAR closed period, and unlike their earlier buys it was not tied to a release.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Management buys after every release (Mar, May 2026), and those prints still went -8.9% and +0.2%, so the buys are a weak signal on this name.
findings.why_not_priced: Token size (about EUR 10-15k each), so the market ignores it: the stock is +8% since but still below its pre-H1 level. What is informative is the timing, with the quarter's management accounts in hand.

baseline_tension: The findings lean slightly negative, against a small positive priced lean (+0.44, driven by the short-squeeze component of a non-crowded 1.12% short) and a +4.55% 20-day run-up. The negatives are guide arithmetic the market can do itself, so p_up is held near 50 rather than taking the sum at face value.

lessons_applied: 'The move is in the guide' plus 'too small about the move': the two guidance findings went from -0.8/-0.7 to -1.2/-1.0, and abs_move_pct from 4.5 to 5.5 because the quarter is not pre-released and a volume-guide change is plausible
'The reaction history vetoes the direction, not the size': this name went down on 6 of 9 release days (Q3 2025 -4.46%), so p_up went from 45 to 44 and not further, since the negatives are inferences
'A verified fact is not a predicted reaction': the directors' dealings finding went from +0.6 to +0.4 because management buys after most prints and those prints were still sold
